items.en: I often find myself questioning things I hear or read in this course to decide if I find them convincing.
items.zh: 我常常会质疑在这门课上听到或读到的内容，以判断它们是否让我信服。

items.en: When a theory, interpretation, or conclusion is presented in class or in the readings, I try to decide if there is good supporting evidence.
items.zh: 当课堂或阅读材料中提出一种理论、解释或结论时，我会尝试判断它是否有充分的证据支持。

items.en: I treat the course material as a starting point and try to develop my own ideas about it.
items.zh: 我把课程材料当作起点，并尝试在此基础上形成自己的想法。

items.en: I try to play around with ideas of my own related to what I am learning in this course.
items.zh: 我会尝试对这门课所学内容产生自己的想法，并灵活地琢磨这些想法。

items.en: Whenever I read or hear an assertion or conclusion in this class, I think about possible alternatives.
items.zh: 每当在这门课上读到或听到一个论断或结论时，我会思考其他可能的解释。
